2026-09-02.content:
Apigee Edge for Private Cloud release notes are now published on Google Cloud
documentation.

Release notes and patch announcements for Apigee Edge for Private Cloud are
published on the
[Apigee Edge for Private Cloud release notes](https://docs.cloud.google.com/apigee/docs/edge-private-cloud/release-notes)
page from September 2026 onward. You can
[subscribe](https://docs.cloud.google.com/apigee/docs/edge-private-cloud/release-notes#sub) to that page with
a feed reader to be notified when a new release or patch is published.

Release notes published before September 2026 remain available in the
[Apigee Edge release notes archive](https://docs.apigee.com/release/notes/apigee-release-notes).

summary.title: Apigee Edge Private Cloud Release Notes Now Available
summary.summary: Release notes and patch announcements for Apigee Edge for Private Cloud are now published on the Google Cloud documentation site starting September 2026. Older release notes are available in the Apigee Edge release notes archive.
